profiles.name: Aromaphile

constraints.summary: This archetype is restricted to Ghoran characters.

evidence.section: Hypnotic Aroma / Debilitating Aroma / Aromatic Manipulation
evidence.reason: Hypnotic Aroma / Debilitating Aroma / Aromatic Manipulation defines the material change from the Mesmerist baseline.

profiles.playerSummary: Rather than employ the baleful glares of the typical mesmerist, aromaphiles hypnotize others using an array of sickeningly sweet scents developed from their unique ghoran physiology.
profiles.tradeoff: It replaces or alters Hypnotic Stare; Painful Stare; Towering Ego; Bold Stare; Touch Treatment; Mental Potency; those base-class tools are exchanged for the archetype’s more specialised package.
